title: CHOOSEROWS counts negative selectors from the bottom, flattens array selectors row-major, and rejects 0 or out-of-bounds with #VALUE!
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, CHOOSEROWS(array, row_num1, ...) selects 1-based rows in the order given (permitting duplicates and reordering), counts negative selectors from the last row (-1 selects the final row), truncates fractional selectors toward zero, flattens array selectors in row-major order, and returns #VALUE! when any selector is 0 or its magnitude exceeds the array's row count. All 3,000 full-bank CHOOSEROWS rows match.
basis: Measured in DnaCalc f3_arrays row 22, jnt_aggregate_arrays rows 79-86 (Excel 16.0.20527.20088), and CalcFunc-Evidence admit2-answers-chooserows-spill.json (Excel 16.0 build 20527); 3,000/3,000 full-bank rows match.
